verdict.rationale: Crossplane's first-party docs say to install the core product with its Helm chart into an existing Kubernetes cluster you control (`helm install crossplane --namespace crossplane-system ...`), which creates the Crossplane pod. They also document dry-run inspection, feature flags and pre-release channels. Community commenters describe running it on their own clusters (e.g. on Rancher) and note you must set up your own Kubernetes, which confirms the self-hosted model. Missing for 10: an explicit open-source license statement in the evidence, and hands-on independent install reports beyond brief comments.
